blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Lorene Toring was grateful to find her new home at Choco Mucho and to team up with her fellow Cebuanos like Sisi Rondina-Rosales. Just days after her signing was announced, Toring made an immediate impact, helping Choco Mucho complete its comeback win over Capital1 for an impressive start in the 10th season of the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday. “I’m really happy I ended up with Choco because I look up to so many of the players, especially my fellow Cebuanos and Ate Eya (Laure).
